thread:
erin: follow-up from today's postmortem on streaming partials/timeouts. need owners + short timelines. main areas: client reconnect policy, server stream framing/backpressure, and detect/alert. please claim.
pat: i can own server framing/backpressure. initial plan: add defensive frame validation, fix kv-cache reorder edge, and add a fast-path abort for stuck async flushes. target patch + unit tests by Mon 2026-03-30.
alexa: i'll take client SDK changes. propose unified reconnect policy (exp jitter), limit parallel reconnects, expose a diagnostics hook. i'll draft RFC and SDK PR by Fri 2026-03-27.
corey: observability & runbook owner. will add metrics: streaming.partial_fragment_rate and streaming.reconnect_success; set SLI/alerts and a rollout checklist. panels + alert rules to staging by Wed 2026-03-25.
deploy-bot: created BUG-4987 (server-framing), RFC-4988 (client-reconnect), DOC-4989 (streaming-observability). Links: https://tracker/redwood/BUG-4987, https://tracker/redwood/RFC-4988, https://tracker/redwood/DOC-4989
erin: recurring pattern note: similar signature to Feb incident where autoscaler + heartbeat miss correlated with partials. action: monthly digest to correlate deploys, autoscaler events, and partials. platform rotation to own it.
pat: test plan note: add chaos job that induces 300/s ephemeral connection churn and toggles kv-cache TTLs. need a canary pool. @corey can you schedule?
corey: reserving canary-7 Tue 2026-03-31 07:00-09:00 PT. will add runbook steps for rollback triggers.
alexa: client reconnect RFC snippet:
```
reconnect:
  strategy: exp-jitter
  base_ms: 120
  max_ms: 4000
  attempts: 6
  max_parallel_reconnects: 2
```
will include telemetry for reconnect_reason and resume_success.
erin: rollout plan: server fix canary at 5% then 25% then full over 24-48h if stable. rollback thresholds: partial_fragment_rate > 0.35% or 99p latency +25%.
deploy-bot: BUG-4987 assigned to pat, RFC-4988 to alexa, DOC-4989 to corey.
pat: branch opened https://github.com/redwood/inference/compare/fix/BUG-4987 with unit tests.
alexa: RFC posted https://docs.redwood/rfcs/4988-client-reconnect. SDK PR coming after reviews.
corey: dashboards live in staging: https://grafana.redwood/d/streaming/continuity. alert manager rules in review.
erin: owners recap & deadlines: pat -> 2026-03-30, alexa -> 2026-03-27, corey -> 2026-03-25. 20-min sync Thu 2026-03-26 11:00am PT to confirm. include smoke steps in PRs.
pat: ack.
alexa: ack, will add smoke script for oncall.
corey: ack, will add rollback checklist to runbook.
erin: thanks all. tagging leads @pat @alexa @corey. closing thread for now.
